name: Meta Jeffersonville

timeline.event: Building 1 and 2 shell and cooling look complete, but there's still construction activity. We give it another 3 months to operational.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Jeffersonville: current power 178 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Jeffersonville is an operating AI data center in IN, IN, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 178 MW today and 241 MW when finished.
